en: This is Mr. Chan from building management.
notes: building-manager: polite self-introduction

en: There's a problem with the water pipe on the 8th floor.
notes: building-manager: reporting an issue

en: We need to come into your unit to check it.
yue_reference: 我哋要入嚟你個單位查一查。
notes: building-manager: requesting entry, colloquial 入嚟

en: Are you free tomorrow afternoon, around 2pm?
yue_reference: 你聽日下晝兩點左右得唔得閒？
notes: building-manager: scheduling, 得唔得閒 = free?

en: No problem, we can reschedule whenever suits you.
yue_reference: 冇問題，你幾時方便我哋就幾時改期。
notes: building-manager: reassuring, 冇問題

en: The water will be shut off for about an hour.
notes: building-manager: 一個鐘 = one hour (colloquial)

en: Please remember to open the door for me.
notes: building-manager: reminder, sentence particle 呀

en: The lift will be under maintenance this weekend.
notes: building-manager: 部𨋢 = the lift (colloquial)

en: Someone reported that your bathroom is leaking.
yue_reference: 有人話你個廁所漏緊水。
notes: building-manager: 話 = said, 漏緊水 = leaking now

en: I'll bring my colleague along to help.
yue_reference: 我會帶埋我同事嚟幫手。
notes: building-manager: 帶埋 = bring along, 幫手 = help

en: Please take me to Mong Kok MTR station.
yue_reference: 唔該載我去旺角地鐵站。
notes: taxi: 唔該 = please, 載 = take/drive

en: Can you stop at the next corner?
yue_reference: 可唔可以喺下個街口停？
notes: taxi: 喺 = at, 街口 = street corner

en: How much is it to the airport?
notes: taxi: asking fare, 幾多錢

en: Please take the tunnel, it's faster.
notes: taxi: 行隧道 = go through the tunnel, 快啲 = faster

en: Turn left at the next set of lights.
notes: taxi: 燈位 = traffic light spot

en: I'm in a hurry, could you go a bit faster?
yue_reference: 我趕時間，可唔可以快啲呀？
notes: taxi: 趕時間 = in a hurry

en: Can you drop me off in front of that building?
yue_reference: 可唔可以喺嗰棟大廈門口落我？
notes: taxi: 落我 = let me off, 嗰棟大廈 = that building

en: Do you take Octopus card?
notes: taxi: 八達通 = Octopus card, 收唔收 = accept?

en: It's just past the market, on the right.
yue_reference: 過咗個街市就係，喺右手邊。
notes: taxi: 過咗 = after passing, 街市 = wet market

en: Please wait here for five minutes.
notes: taxi: 喺度 = here, 等我 = wait for me

en: How much is the grouper per catty?
notes: market: 石斑 = grouper, 斤 = catty

en: The prawns are really fresh today.
notes: market: 啲 = the (plural), 好新鮮 = very fresh

en: Can you make it a bit cheaper?
notes: market: 平啲 = cheaper, bargaining

en: I'll take half a catty of choy sum.
notes: market: 菜心 = choy sum, 半斤 = half a catty

en: Is this spicy?
notes: market/food: 辣唔辣 = spicy or not, particle 㗎

en: One bowl of wonton noodles, please.
notes: food: 雲吞麵 = wonton noodles, 一碗 = one bowl

en: Less oil and less salt, thanks.
notes: food: ordering preference

en: Do you have anything cheaper?
notes: market: 有冇 = have or not, 嘅 = one(s)

en: I don't want any spring onions, thanks.
notes: food: 唔要 = don't want, 蔥 = spring onion

en: Give me two of these, thanks.
notes: market: 呢啲 = these, 畀...我 = give me
